svg.title: From Idea to Working HMI — OpenHMI Network
svg.desc: Editable conceptual architecture. Product idea → UI design → LVGL engineering → ArtInChip D211BBV hardware with integrated 64 MB DDR2 → working prototype. Hardware is shown in a separated service pose, not to scale. External touch controller, SPI NOR, wireless module and industrial transceivers are board-level components. Not a pinout or validated schematic.
svg.text: D211BBV: integrated 64 MB DDR2 · external SPI NOR · optional radio module · external CAN / RS485 transceivers
